limits: All recovery snapshots are UNTESTED. Earlier validation evidence is not uploaded or claimed for these snapshots.

unrecovered_ap_only_proposal.known_source_kind: Separate unrun appearance-preservation regression/source proposal, not materialized in a registered worktree
unrecovered_ap_only_proposal.reason: Exact file was identified in the earlier intake but was unavailable to the later source proposal reader. It was not backed up; no reconstruction was attempted.
